title: CopilotKit/OpenDots
why_read: An 'always-on AI coworker' product spanning text, calls, and Slack, more of a product announcement than a deep technical contribution.
analysis: OpenDots appears to be a framework or product for building AI agents that can participate across multiple communication channels like text chat, voice calls, and Slack, acting as persistent virtual coworkers. This fits a broader trend of agentic AI assistants embedding themselves into everyday workplace communication tools. There's limited information here about the underlying architecture or technical innovation, making it hard to judge beyond a product pitch.
